stemBlocks: An object of mass 40 kg is placed on a uniform, horizontal plank of mass 10 kg between two supports X and Y as shown in the diagram.
What is the contact force at X?

assets.alt: A uniform horizontal plank is supported at points X and Y. An object is placed on the plank. Distances are indicated: 1.0 m from X to the object, 1.0 m from the object to the center of the plank, and 2.0 m from the center of the plank to Y.
